source_request: [$photo-prompt-image-generator](/Users/chasoik/Projects/image-prompt/skills/photo-prompt-image-generator/SKILL.md) 절벽 위에 서서 떠오르는 해를 보며 만족스럽게 풍경을 내려다보는 트레저헌터의 뒷모습
interpreted_intent: A triumphant but quiet cinematic adventure portrait in which the adult treasure hunter from the supplied appearance reference pauses at a cliff edge and takes satisfied pleasure in the sunrise landscape below.
subject: A clearly adult woman treasure hunter whose long silver-ash twin ponytails preserve the supplied portrait's most legible appearance cue from behind.
setting: A high rugged cliff overlooking a vast mountain valley, winding river, forest, and distant ancient ruins at sunrise.
event: She stands at the cliff edge, watches the rising sun, and calmly surveys the landscape below with visibly satisfied body language.
visual_priorities: An immense sunrise landscape with layered depth and warm natural atmosphere.
A recognizable rear-view silhouette whose relaxed posture communicates earned satisfaction.
baseline_prompt_en: A wide cinematic adventure photograph of the same clearly adult woman suggested by the supplied portrait, recognizable from behind by her long silver-ash twin ponytails, now dressed as a seasoned treasure hunter in a weathered leather field jacket, utility belt, sturdy trousers, boots, and a compact explorer's pack. She stands at the edge of a high rugged cliff, viewed fully from behind, quietly surveying a vast valley at sunrise. The rising sun breaks over distant mountains, turning mist-filled rivers, forest, and ancient ruins below into layers of amber and pale gold. Her shoulders are relaxed, chin slightly lifted, and stance calm and grounded, expressing satisfied pride after a difficult journey. Wind lifts her ponytails and jacket hem. Emphasize the immense landscape, solitary victorious silhouette, realistic natural light, tactile worn gear, and photographic detail.
